_comment: Curated figures and short quotes for the 'What Companies Report' section of the American Consumer page. Every value and quote is taken from the company's own results release (Form 8-K, Item 2.02, exhibits stored under raw/releases/) and carries the text it was read from (`find`): the builder refuses a record whose text is not in the stored exhibit of the filing dated `filed`. Updated in a session after each earnings season; `reviewed` is the date of the last pass. `ex` names the exhibit when it is not the first one. trafficSign / ticketSign: the release says the direction without a figure. Gig platforms: `us` lists what the company reports for the United States (scope `us`) or for the narrowest geography that contains it (`usca` = United States and Canada), each entry citing its own report through `filed` and `form` (10-Q, 10-K, or `page:<id>` for a company page kept by the harvester); `of` / `ofFind` give the company total of the same line; `scope.find` is the sentence that states the geography.
